summary: 28-year-old struck by microwave-sized falling rock at base of Tortoise Scute, Other Critters Crag, Clear Creek Canyon; died after being taken off life support.
location: Clear Creek Canyon, Other Critters Crag
notes: Victim Cameron Maxwell, 28, of Loveland; rock fell from a route above moments after he finished his lead; wearing a helmet; died 2021-12-13.; Merged 2 reports (parts: aac, news-2020-2023); date per both sources. UN pre-death piece (published 2021-12-06, two days post-rescue) reported him alive/injured at rescue; DB outcome fatality per AAC (died 2021-12-13).
